description: Defines an enum JavaType representing various Java data types, including primitive, object, date/time, binary, collection, and other types. Provides methods for type classification, matching, and parsing string representations.

classes.name: JavaType
classes.description: Enumeration of Java data types with methods for type classification, matching, and parsing.

methods.name: getTypeClass
methods.description: Returns the Java Class associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: isPrimitive
methods.description: Checks if the type is a primitive type.

methods.name: isBooleanType
methods.description: Checks if the type is boolean or Boolean.

methods.name: isByteType
methods.description: Checks if the type is byte or Byte.

methods.name: isShortType
methods.description: Checks if the type is short or Short.

methods.name: isIntegerType
methods.description: Checks if the type is int or Integer.

methods.name: isLongType
methods.description: Checks if the type is long or Long.

methods.name: isAnyIntegerType
methods.description: Checks if the type is any integer type.

methods.name: isFloatType
methods.description: Checks if the type is float or Float.

methods.name: isDoubleType
methods.description: Checks if the type is double or Double.

methods.name: isAnyFloatType
methods.description: Checks if the type is any float type.

methods.name: isDecimalType
methods.description: Checks if the type is BigDecimal.

methods.name: isObjectNumericType
methods.description: Checks if the type is a numeric object type.

methods.name: isPrimitiveNumericType
methods.description: Checks if the type is a primitive numeric type.

methods.name: isNumericType
methods.description: Checks if the type is any numeric type.

methods.name: isStringType
methods.description: Checks if the type is String.

methods.name: isCharacterType
methods.description: Checks if the type is char or Character.

methods.name: isDateType
methods.description: Checks if the type is Date or LocalDate.

methods.name: isTimeType
methods.description: Checks if the type is Time, LocalTime, or OffsetTime.

methods.name: isDateTimeType
methods.description: Checks if the type is Timestamp, LocalDateTime, or OffsetDateTime.

methods.name: isAnyDateType
methods.description: Checks if the type is any date/time type.

methods.name: isBinaryType
methods.description: Checks if the type is byte array.

methods.name: getPrimitiveType
methods.description: Returns the primitive equivalent of the type, if applicable.

methods.name: getObjectType
methods.description: Returns the object wrapper type of the primitive, if applicable.

methods.name: forType
methods.description: Returns the JavaType corresponding to a given Class.

methods.name: matchType
methods.description: Checks if a Class matches this JavaType.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if an object is the default value for this type.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a String into an Object of this JavaType.
